entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: Hey, aren't you interested in all[n]the hottest brand names?

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: We're having a special sale just over there.[n]How 'bout you go take a peek?

entries.speaker: Pierced Man
entries.en: We ordered way too much,[n]so I have a ton left over.

entries.speaker: Pierced Man
entries.en: My boss'll kill me if I go back to him[n]with all these extras.

entries.speaker: Pierced Man
entries.en: Look, I'll sell 'em to you for cheap.[n]Whaddya say?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: It depends on the price, wouldn't you say?

entries.speaker: Pierced Man
entries.en: Hey, what about you?[n]These are unforgettable deals.

entries.speaker: Pierced Man
entries.en: Well that's disappointing. Come back[n]if you change your mind.

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: C'mon, the shop's right around here.[n]How about you come take a look?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It seems like some kind of sale.[n]You probably shouldn't bother.

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: You're free to look as much as you want.[n]It's fine by me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, don't talk to him. Let's get moving.
